abstract: Six cases of pregnancy associated malignant ovarian tumors, four epithelial cancers, one immature teratoma and one metastatic cancer of colon origin, are reported. One patient with mucinous cystadenocarcinoma had a history of persistent ovarian tumor during her past three pregnancies. Another patient was found to have mucinous cystadenocarcinoma after an emergency operation for twisted ovarian tumor. Immature teratoma associated with pregnancy is very rare and our case seems to be the 8th reported such case.
abstract_ja: 妊娠に伴う悪性卵巣腫瘍の6例を報告する。内訳は上皮性癌4例、未熟奇形腫1例、大腸由来の転移性癌1例である。粘液性嚢胞腺癌の1例は過去3回の妊娠中に持続する卵巣腫瘍の既往があった。別の患者は捻転した卵巣腫瘍の緊急手術後に粘液性嚢胞腺癌と診断された。妊娠に伴う未熟奇形腫は非常にまれで、本例は報告された8例目と考えられる。
